about: SL-005 review M1 (O-015), closed as a class: gone codes caused by losing the volume, drive letter or share ABOVE a folder, not the folder itself. A folder whose open found no folder (2) or no path (3) is deleted only while the scan root still opens (Scanner.FolderVanished with Scanner.GoneGivenRootOpen); when the root does not, the same code is a path that stopped resolving and the folder stays unreadable as before. The class is bounded by who produces its members: a person pulling a USB drive, removing a SUBST or net use mapping, a share or VPN dropping, another program deleting the scan root, a refused root. Each row is fed to the two predicates by VanishedFolderCorpusTests.TheRootOpenTellsADeletedFolderFromAPathThatStoppedResolving; 'live' names the real-scan test that makes the same shape happen on this PC, where one can. 'gone' is the expected verdict.

rows.source: another program deletes a queued folder
another program deletes a folder and the one below it was queued
a SUBST mapping removed while its drive is scanned
the same, where the letter's own path answers 2
a removable drive pulled mid-scan: the letter no longer resolves
net use /d on a mapped drive mid-scan: the letter has no mapping
a share's server stops answering: the root open reports the network path
a share withdrawn by its server
a mapped drive whose connection dropped
a VPN or tunnel down under a share
another program deletes the folder being scanned
a folder whose delete is pending: the open reports access denied
a folder replaced by a file: the open succeeds and the listing fails with 87
a folder that opened and then reported not found while listing
a deny ACE on the folder
